Name: unit06:listening:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "title": "Listening: The economy: power behind everyday life", "question": "Why are economic bubbles by no means the norm?", "options": ["Speculators are nervous about their investment.", "People usually know the intrinsic value of an asset.", "Manufacturers are reluctant to expand production for fear of risk.", "Overpriced products are beyond the purchasing power of customers."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第2段：多数投机者对自己投资的对象心存不安，因此泡沫并非常态（by no means the norm）。"}

Name: unit06:listening:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "title": "Listening: The economy: power behind everyday life", "question": "In a positive feedback system, what would happen when prices increase sharply?", "options": ["Speculators know the prices will fall in the near future.", "Speculators are eager to sell their assets to make a profit.", "Speculators become greedier and buy more assets.", "Speculators become more united to get the best prices."], "answer": 2, "explanation": "第3段：价格一涨，过度热情的投机者会买得更多，错过低价的人也会蜂拥而入，形成“正反馈”。"}

Name: unit06:listening:5
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "title": "Listening: The economy: power behind everyday life", "question": "The “greater fool theory” explains ______.", "options": ["how prices reach dizzying heights", "how people’s foolishness can be avoided", "why buyers buy more than necessary", "why speculators do not flock to the market"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第3段：买家相信会有“更大的傻瓜”出更高价，这种心态互相传染，价格因而被推到令人眩晕的高位。"}

Name: unit06:listening:6
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "title": "Listening: The economy: power behind everyday life", "question": "What will happen when big economic bubbles occur?", "options": ["The involved banks may fail.", "You will be economical with your purchases.", "The market can easily assimilate the bubbles.", "The market can help the winners earn wisdom."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第5段：若负资产情况普遍，就可能“culminate in the failure of those banks”，并重创经济增长所需的信贷。"}

Name: unit06:listening:7
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "title": "Listening: The economy: power behind everyday life", "question": "The “herd mentality” explains ______.", "options": ["how the stock market goes bust", "what happens to a company in economic crises", "how brokers drive the stock prices to unrealistic heights", "how investors buy stock in a company in a reasonable way"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "第6段：herd mentality 指过多经纪人蜂拥买入，把股价推高到不切实际的水平。"}

Name: unit06:listening:8
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "title": "Listening: The economy: power behind everyday life", "question": "What do we know about the “dot-com” bubble?", "options": ["The stock index dropped by about 40 percent in 2002.", "Many companies ended up selling off their assets to other companies.", "The investors were provided with false information about the business.", "The stock index dropped to 1,108.49 right after the boom reached its peak."], "answer": 1, "explanation": "第7段末：多数公司陷入严重财务困境，把资产出售给更健康的公司；股指是在两年半里逐步跌至1,108.49，并非见顶后立即暴跌。"}
